scan_linter_check.description:
Review tier of SN-CFG-001. Flags string literals containing a *.service-now.com or *.servicenowservices.com host other than this instance's, as a URL or a bare host name. These are often integration endpoints or links to other environments that should differ per environment.
Only string literals are checked, so comments and URLs built at run time are not matched. Hosts listed in the system property ecs.cfg.allowed_hosts (comma-separated; default hi.service-now.com) are ignored. This instance's host is read from glide.servlet.uri at scan time, so the same script can be SN-CFG-001 on the instance whose URL it contains and SN-CFG-001-R on every other instance.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-CFG-001-R: Hardcoded ServiceNow instance host
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Build instance URLs at run time with gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri') (this instance) or gs.getProperty('instance_name'). For other instances or endpoints, use a Connection & Credential alias, a REST Message endpoint, or a system property set per environment.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A string literal contains another ServiceNow instance's host name.
